cta.free: Free. The business sees only what you choose to send.
cta.signIn: Sign in to send an enquiry
cta.signInNote: After signing in, come back to this page from the Directory — sign-in does not bring you back here yet.
cta.openNote: You already have an open enquiry with this business.

form.title: Send an enquiry
form.titleQuote: Ask for a quote for an arrangement
form.lead: We filled in what we knew from your plan. Change anything — the business receives exactly what you see here and nothing else.
form.leadQuote: Describe the arrangement or upload a photo or a sketch. The business receives only the arrangement, the date, the approximate guest count and your message.
form.occasionHint: The enquiry appears in this occasion's plan, under suppliers.
form.chooseOccasionBody: An enquiry is sent from the plan of an occasion you manage.
form.noOccasionBody: An enquiry leaves from an occasion's plan. Create the occasion first, then come back here.
form.dateHint: Leave empty if it is not decided yet.
form.budgetHint: Optional. It helps the business answer to the point.
form.messageHint: What would you like to know? Do not write anything you do not want to share.
form.arrangementHint: Colours, flowers to include or avoid, size, where it will stand.
form.shareEmailHint: If you leave this unticked, the business answers only here, in EventDesk, and does not see your address.
form.shareEmailNoEmail: Your account has no email address, so the business will answer here, in EventDesk.
form.sharedBody: The fields above and your message. Your name, the guest list, the plan's budget and the rest of the plan stay private.
form.leftOccasion: Enquiries left for this occasion: {left} of {max}.
form.leftToday: Enquiries left today on your account: {left} of {max}.
form.limitOccasionTitle: You have reached {max} enquiries for this occasion
form.limitOccasionBody: You can continue the threads already open from the occasion's plan, under suppliers.
form.sharedBodyQuote: The arrangement (the description and the photo, if you uploaded one), the date, the approximate guest count and the message. Nothing else from the plan.

planner.listDescription: Each enquiry sits with its supplier in the plan. An unanswered enquiry stays visible, with the date it left.
planner.emptyBody: Find a business in the Directory and write to it from its page. The enquiry appears here and with its supplier in the plan.
planner.supplier: See the supplier in the plan

thread.emailNotSharedBusiness: The planner did not send their address. Reply here.
thread.imageAlt: The photo or sketch of the arrangement
thread.replyHint: The business receives it here, in EventDesk.
thread.replyBusinessHint: The planner reads it in their plan.
thread.quoteFileHint: One PDF of at most 10 MB. It marks the planner's booking as "quote received".
thread.closeBody: No more messages can be sent in it. It stays in the plan, with everything that was written.
thread.closedNotice: This enquiry is closed. No more messages can be sent.
thread.resendBody: You can re-send the enquiry once. It stays the same thread; the business is notified again.
thread.resendFrom: If the business does not reply, you can re-send it once from {date}.
thread.resent: The enquiry was re-sent {date}. It cannot be re-sent again.
thread.reportBody: A moderator will read it. The thread stays open until you close it.
thread.acceptBody: The quote is attached to the supplier in the plan and the booking becomes "booked". The agreed amount enters the budget as this supplier's commitment.
thread.acceptAmountHint: As written in the quote. Leave empty if you do not know it yet — it stays "unknown".
thread.acceptNoFinance: Someone with budget access can fill in the amount.
thread.changes: What changed since the previous acceptance
thread.designChanged: The design has changed since the quote was accepted. Ask for a new quote for the current version.
thread.readOnly: Only the owner or the project manager can write in the enquiry.
thread.sendFailed: The message could not be sent. Check your internet connection and try again.

inbox.title: Enquiries received
inbox.description: Enquiries and quote requests sent by planners. Anyone on the team can reply.
inbox.emptyOpenBody: When a planner writes to you from a listing's page, the enquiry appears here and you get an email.
inbox.nudgeOn: You get one reminder after 48 hours for unanswered enquiries.
inbox.nudgeOff: The 48-hour reminder is off. The notice when an enquiry arrives stays.

errors.unclaimed: This listing has not been claimed yet and cannot receive enquiries. Use the public contact shown on its page.
errors.occasionLimit: You have reached the limit of {max} enquiries for this occasion. Continue the threads already open from the plan.
errors.dailyLimit: You have already sent {max} enquiries today. You can send again tomorrow.
errors.alreadyOpen: You already have an open enquiry with this business for the chosen occasion. You will find it in the plan, under suppliers.
errors.date: Write the date as day.month.year or leave the field empty.
errors.guests: Write a whole number, at least 1, or leave the field empty.
errors.county: Choose a county from the list.
errors.locality: Choose a locality from the list.
errors.localityOutsideCounty: The locality is not in the chosen county.
errors.noEmailToShare: Your account has no email address to send. Untick the box.
errors.notFloral: Flower quote requests go only to florists and decoration businesses.
errors.imageNotYours: Upload the photo again: the file does not belong to this occasion.
errors.threadFull: The thread has reached {max} messages. Close it and continue with the business directly.
errors.resendAnswered: The business has already replied — write to them in the thread.
errors.resendOnce: The enquiry has already been re-sent once.
errors.resendTooEarly: The enquiry can be re-sent after {days} days without a reply.
errors.quotePdf: The quote must be a PDF file.
errors.noQuote: The chosen message contains no quote.
errors.noBooking: This enquiry's supplier was deleted from the plan. Add it again to accept the quote.
errors.amount: Write the amount in figures, for example 1,500 or 1500.50.
errors.quoteNoRoom: The file could not be attached: the occasion's file space is full. Send the quote as text or tell the planner.

arrival.subject: New enquiry for {listing}
arrival.body: A planner has sent an enquiry to the listing "{listing}" on EventDesk.

resent.subject: Enquiry re-sent for {listing}
resent.body: The planner has re-sent the enquiry to "{listing}", unanswered for more than 7 days.

nudge.subject: An enquiry for {listing} is waiting for a reply
nudge.body: An enquiry to "{listing}" has had no reply for 48 hours. This is the only reminder for it.

kind.enquiry: It is a request for information.
kind.quote_request: It is a quote request for a flower arrangement.

email.footer: Reply from the business account, in EventDesk. The 48-hour reminder can be turned off in the business settings; the arrival notice cannot.
